options.content:
## Claude Unified Reporting (Platform + Enterprise)
Merges only the metrics that are semantically equivalent between the sibling [`claude`](../../backend/plugins/claude/) plugin (Provider `claude`, Claude Code only, `_tool_claude_usage` -> `ai_activities`) and the [`claude_enterprise`](../../backend/plugins/claude_enterprise/) plugin (Provider `claude_enterprise`, `ai_activities` + `_tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports` / `_tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports`).

Use the **Source** variable above to filter every panel to Platform only, Enterprise only, or both combined (`All`).

**Sections:**
1. *Unified Claude Code Activity* -- sessions, lines, commits, PRs, tool suggestions/acceptance. Both sources report these for Claude Code (`type = 'CODE_EDIT'`) at the same connection+date+user grain.
2. *Unified Tokens & Cost (Claude Code Only)* -- token and USD cost totals, restricted to the Claude Code product on both sides so the comparison stays apples-to-apples (Enterprise also reports Chat/Cowork spend that the Platform plugin never collects; that broader breakdown stays on `ClaudeEnterpriseAdoption.json`, not here).
3. *Enterprise-Only Adoption* -- seats, DAU/WAU/MAU, and chat conversations. The Platform plugin has no equivalent for these, so they are never merged into a cross-source total; they still honor the Source filter and read as zero when Source = `claude`.

**Known limitation carried over from the Platform plugin:** `claude`-side activity metrics (sessions/lines/commits/PRs/tool actions) are de-duplicated per (date, user) before summing, because `_tool_claude_usage` repeats those daily totals on every per-model row (see implementation-plan.md Section 11, defect #2). Token and cost figures are **not** de-duplicated because they are genuinely distinct per model row.

panels.description: Unified across Platform (`claude`) and Enterprise (`claude_enterprise`) Claude Code activity (`type = 'CODE_EDIT'`). Platform rows are de-duplicated per (date, user) before aggregation because `_tool_claude_usage` repeats this value on every per-model row (Section 11 defect #2); Enterprise rows already carry no model-level duplication (Section 9). Filter with the Source variable. Counts a user once even if active on both sources.

targets.rawSql:
WITH claude_activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
enterprise_activity AS (
  SELECT date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude_enterprise' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
unified_activity AS (
  SELECT 'claude' AS source, date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM claude_activity
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'claude_enterprise' AS source, date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM enterprise_activity
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) AS "Code-Active Users"
FROM unified_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR source = '$source')

panels.description: Users ranked by lines added, split by source so a user active on both sources appears as two rows (one per source) rather than being merged into a single blended total.

targets.rawSql:
WITH claude_activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
enterprise_activity AS (
  SELECT date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude_enterprise' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
unified_activity AS (
  SELECT 'claude' AS source, date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM claude_activity
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'claude_enterprise' AS source, date, user_email, num_sessions, lines_added, lines_removed,
    commits_created, prs_created, suggestions_count, acceptance_count
  FROM enterprise_activity
)
SELECT source AS "Source",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), 'Unknown User') AS "User",
  COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "Active Days",
  SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions",
  SUM(lines_added) AS "Lines Added",
  SUM(commits_created) AS "Commits",
  SUM(prs_created) AS "PRs"
FROM unified_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR source = '$source')
GROUP BY source, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), 'Unknown User')
ORDER BY SUM(lines_added) DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top Users - Unified Code Activity

panels.description: Unified Claude Code token usage. Platform tokens come from `ai_activities` (provider='claude', legitimately per-model, no de-duplication needed -- only the activity totals are duplicated per model row, not tokens). Enterprise tokens come from `_tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports` (tokens are never converted into `ai_activities` for Enterprise -- see Section 9), restricted to `product = 'claude_code'` so the comparison excludes Enterprise Chat/Cowork usage that has no Platform equivalent.

targets.rawSql:
WITH claude_tokens AS (
  SELECT date, model, input_tokens, output_tokens
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
enterprise_tokens AS (
  SELECT DATE(STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')) AS date, model, input_tokens, output_tokens
  FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports
  WHERE LOWER(product) IN ('claude_code', 'claude-code', 'code')
),
unified_tokens AS (
  SELECT 'claude' AS source, date, model, input_tokens, output_tokens FROM claude_tokens
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'claude_enterprise' AS source, date, model, input_tokens, output_tokens FROM enterprise_tokens
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) AS "Total Tokens"
FROM unified_tokens
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR source = '$source')

panels.title: Claude Code Tokens (Period)

panels.description: Unified Claude Code USD cost. Platform cost comes from `ai_activities` (provider='claude', legitimately per-model). Enterprise cost comes from `_tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports` (amounts are decimal strings cast to DECIMAL, USD rows only), restricted to `product = 'claude_code'` for the same reason as tokens above.

targets.rawSql:
WITH claude_cost AS (
  SELECT date, model, estimated_cost_usd AS amount
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
enterprise_cost AS (
  SELECT DATE(STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')) AS date, model, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS amount
  FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports
  WHERE LOWER(product) IN ('claude_code', 'claude-code', 'code')
    AND UPPER(currency) = 'USD'
),
unified_cost AS (
  SELECT 'claude' AS source, date, model, amount FROM claude_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'claude_enterprise' AS source, date, model, amount FROM enterprise_cost
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2), 0) AS "Total Cost (USD)"
FROM unified_cost
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR source = '$source')

panels.title: Cost (USD) Over Time by Source

panels.description: Unified Claude Code USD cost. Platform cost comes from `ai_activities` (provider='claude', legitimately per-model). Enterprise cost comes from `_tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports` (amounts are decimal strings cast to DECIMAL, USD rows only), restricted to `product = 'claude_code'` for the same reason as tokens above. Grouped by source and model so totals are never blended across the two plugins.

targets.rawSql:
WITH claude_cost AS (
  SELECT date, model, estimated_cost_usd AS amount
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE provider = 'claude' AND type = 'CODE_EDIT'
),
enterprise_cost AS (
  SELECT DATE(STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')) AS date, model, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS amount
  FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports
  WHERE LOWER(product) IN ('claude_code', 'claude-code', 'code')
    AND UPPER(currency) = 'USD'
),
unified_cost AS (
  SELECT 'claude' AS source, date, model, amount FROM claude_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'claude_enterprise' AS source, date, model, amount FROM enterprise_cost
)
SELECT source AS "Source",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'Unknown') AS "Model",
  ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS "Cost (USD)"
FROM unified_cost
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR source = '$source')
GROUP BY source, COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'Unknown')
ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC

panels.title: Cost by Model (by Source)

panels.description: Enterprise-only: the Platform (`claude`) plugin has no seats/adoption concept, so this is never merged into a unified total. Reads as zero when Source = claude. Uses the latest summary row per (connection, scope) in range, matching ClaudeEnterpriseAdoption.json.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_summary AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries s
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT connection_id, scope_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries
    WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
      AND ('$source' = 'All' OR '$source' = 'claude_enterprise')
    GROUP BY connection_id, scope_id
  ) latest
    ON latest.connection_id = s.connection_id
   AND latest.scope_id = s.scope_id
   AND latest.max_date = s.date
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(assigned_seats), 0) AS "Assigned Seats"
FROM latest_summary

panels.title: Assigned Seats (Latest, Enterprise-only)

panels.description: Enterprise-only: the Platform (`claude`) plugin has no seats/adoption concept, so this is never merged into a unified total. Reads as zero when Source = claude. Uses the latest summary row per (connection, scope) in range, matching ClaudeEnterpriseAdoption.json.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_summary AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries s
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT connection_id, scope_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries
    WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
      AND ('$source' = 'All' OR '$source' = 'claude_enterprise')
    GROUP BY connection_id, scope_id
  ) latest
    ON latest.connection_id = s.connection_id
   AND latest.scope_id = s.scope_id
   AND latest.max_date = s.date
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(daily_active_users) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(assigned_seats), 0), 1), 0) AS "DAU / Seats %"
FROM latest_summary

panels.title: DAU / Seats Adoption Rate % (Latest, Enterprise-only)

panels.description: Enterprise-only: the Platform (`claude`) plugin has no seats/adoption concept, so this is never merged into a unified total. Reads as zero when Source = claude. Uses the latest summary row per (connection, scope) in range, matching ClaudeEnterpriseAdoption.json.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time,
  SUM(daily_active_users) AS "Daily Active Users",
  SUM(weekly_active_users) AS "Weekly Active Users",
  SUM(monthly_active_users) AS "Monthly Active Users"
FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries
WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR '$source' = 'claude_enterprise')
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

panels.description: Enterprise-only: the Platform (`claude`) plugin only ever tracks Claude Code, never chat, so this has no unified equivalent. Reads as zero when Source = claude.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(num_sessions) AS "Chat Conversations"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND provider = 'claude_enterprise'
  AND type = 'CHAT'
  AND ('$source' = 'All' OR '$source' = 'claude_enterprise')
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date
